N1.s: Ai folosit cele %lld cutling-uri gratuite. Continuă în Cutling, deblochează-l și se salvează și acesta.
N1.back: You-have used the 5 cutlings free. Continue in Cutling, unlock-it and self saves also this-one.
N1.why: Same order as S28, an imperative then what follows from it; „Continuă în” echoes the system's continue-in-app choice, and „și acesta” sets this item beside the five.

N2.s: Ai folosit cele %lld cutling-uri gratuite. Deschide Cutling și deblochează mai multe.
N2.back: You-have used the 5 cutlings free. Open Cutling and unlock more.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1 and N7 so the state has one wording; nothing can continue in the app here, so it says where to go, and „mai multe” agrees with the neuter plural cutling-uri.

N3.s: Salvat. Mai ai un loc gratis.
N3.back: Saved. More you-have one place free.
N3.why: „Mai ai” is how a Romanian says something is still left; „gratis” is the keyboard's word, as in K1.

N4.why: The count pair from S29 in the keyboard's „gratis”; 5 din 5 says the free places are full without a second sentence.

N5.why: Same count pair as N4, then the verb for the tap; „și-l” is the spoken contraction that fits the 40-character bar, and the item is the „-l”.

N6.why: The same verb as S15 so one action keeps one word; 11 characters, one over the budget, because the imperative has no shorter form.

N7.s: Ai folosit cele %lld cutling-uri gratuite. Deblochează Cutling și se salvează și acesta.
N7.back: You-have used the 5 cutlings free. Unlock Cutling and self saves also this-one.
N7.why: The item is on screen in the form above, so „acesta” points at it; same shape as N1 so the two places say the same thing.

N8.s: Am păstrat ce voiai să salvezi. Deschide Cutling, deblochează-l și se salvează.
N8.back: I-have kept what you-wanted to save. Open Cutling, unlock-it and self saves.
N8.why: First person singular as in S19 and M8; „ce voiai să salvezi” names the item without stacking „cutling-ul” beside Cutling.
